mapper.insert: INSERT INTO takku_product ( store_id, product_name, price, description, created_at ) VALUES ( #{storeId}, #{productName}, #{price}, #{description}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT p.product_id, p.store_id, p.product_name, p.price, p.description, p.created_at, ( SELECT ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 1) FROM takku_review r WHERE r.product_id = p.product_id ) AS average_rating FROM takku_product p WHERE p.store_id = #{storeId}
mapper.update: UPDATE takku_product SET product_name = #{productName}, price = #{price}, description = #{description} WHERE product_id = #{productId}
